That fits the Food Code's four-hour option: food taken out of hot holding at 135°F (57°C) or above must be marked with the time four hours after it left temperature control, and served or discarded within those four hours, and written procedures must be prepared in advance, kept in the establishment and made available to the regulatory authority on request.
